Korea has failed to reach the Round of 32 at the North and Central America World Cup.
Head coach Hong Myung-bo has stepped down, taking responsibility for the team's group-stage exit.
Speaking in Mexico, Hong apologized to the Korean public, bringing a bitter end to Korea’s World Cup campaign.
